First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support --channel. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against SHA256SUMS, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable jcode on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted .exe.

From that preview binary, run jcode update --channel preview (substitute its full path for jcode) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with update --channel stable, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the v1.0.0 stable tag is created.

What's Changed

🚨 Security

  • Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207
  • test: add integration test coverage and fix KuzuDB fork crashes by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/209

🚀 Features

  • feat(hooks): auto-reindex after git commit with embeddings preservation by @L1nusB in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/205
  • feat: HTTP embedding backend for self-hosted/remote endpoints by @zm2231 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/395
  • feat: complete Swift support — query fix, export detection, implicit imports, constructor resolution by @marxo126 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/408
  • feat(cli): add 'index' command to register existing .gitnexus/ folder by @adonisdoda in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/402
  • feat: add docker support by @BRAINIFII in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/848

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • fix: add preinstall cleanup to prevent ENOTEMPTY on global upgrade by @magyargergo with @Copilot in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/843

v0.8.212 Stable2026-10-28T13:04:51Z

HyperFrames v0.8.212

Released on 2026-10-28.

A model download that stalls now resumes instead of failing. Failures with --json answer in one shape, and check shows progress as it runs.

Fixes

  • CLI: Exit 2 for remaining flag validation errors (2d3033c71, #6639).
  • CLI: Snapshot warns when a video on screen has no source to read a frame from (b84762230, #6656).
  • CLI: Every --json failure answers with one envelope, and --json only where supported (85efaece7, #6622).
  • CLI: A check page forces a WebGL drawing buffer but keeps no list of 2d canvases (b6eaed7ca, #6650).
  • Inspector: Live queries see every composition, wherever the playhead is (205c1a31d, #6651).
  • CLI: Resume a model download that stalls partway instead of failing (ecad35a22, #6649).
  • Studio: A thumbnail reader forgets a start's failures after a minute (a88751d9d, #6642).
  • Studio Server: The render route passes a MOV ProRes profile to the render (5a0179b88, #6644).
  • Engine: A Windows browser that will not start says where and why (7758d9b8f, #6647).
  • CLI: Add help [cmd], suggest the closest command or flag, and quiet the nags (e2c915132, #6621).
  • CLI: Check prints a progress line as each pass after overlap begins (3d1c0764a, #6646).

Internal

  • Studio: Wait for the first undo press before the edit that should block the second (7112e4b6b, #6652).
  • Keep the bun cache warm and skip binary downloads in preflight (0e32ee9b5, #6648).

v0.8.211 Stable2026-10-28T10:03:38Z

HyperFrames v0.8.211

Released on 2026-10-28.

Graded clips now draw on real GPUs instead of showing a blank frame, including clips zoomed far past the screen. New blank projects also start on black, not grey.

Fixes

  • CLI: Local servers never bind a port Chromium refuses to load from (bf7ebe961, #6620).
  • Dx: Unblock lint and the Claude pre-commit hook on Windows (310488b05, #6619).
  • CLI: A new blank project starts on a black frame, not grey (4f0bdfb52, #6614).
  • Core: A graded clip's canvas no longer comes out blank on a real GPU (9eaf9efb6, #6615).
  • Producer: A path whose name starts with two dots now counts as inside its folder (c8052fbda, #5834).

Performance

  • CLI: Check's craft pass skips clips the runtime has hidden (815ff9ec8, #6627).

Docs & Examples

  • Audio: Say the render sums tracks at unity and limits nothing (8b1f88b3c, #5652).

Internal

  • Codegen: Resync cloud client from EF 354b4cf4 (32e171ca9, #6608).

v0.8.210 Stable2026-10-28T01:22:14Z

HyperFrames v0.8.210

Released on 2026-10-27.

MOV renders can now pick a ProRes profile, and HDR sources render correctly to formats that cannot carry HDR. A page whose renderer crashes now fails at once with a clear reason instead of hanging.

Features

  • CLI: Render --prores-profile picks ProRes 4444, hq, 422, lt or proxy for MOV (957df5c268c66, #6581).
  • CLI: Doctor names the tested ffmpeg build and says loudness is only comparable on it (98e774384efdc, #6566).

Fixes

  • CLI: A page whose renderer crashes fails at once, named as the crash (439d6856780f0, #6598).
  • Producer: HDR sources are tone-mapped for formats that cannot carry HDR (313792408d641, #6597).
  • Engine: Extraction waits out the decode up to a deep seek in a long-GOP video (3b2058a2b7a2e, #6583).
  • Preview: The proxy copy for the video at the playhead is made ahead of the rest (bff39004b0312, #6586).
  • CLI: Hyperframes add keeps going when Windows holds the file it replaces (e21fd123fd8f8, #6576).
  • CLI: A killed remove-background run no longer leaves its CoreML temp files behind (0a703edc6f119, #6582).
  • Engine: Mux uppercase WebM exports with Opus audio (1d4aadc1fb436, #6579).
  • Producer: Stop HDR video windows after the first from repeating one frame (07b0f2cda1cf7, #6575).
  • CLI: Check fails a full-frame element that covers every other clip, naming it (2a0fa7f4de970, #6572).
  • CLI: A failed --against reference no longer also says it has no frame (696ca8f779cd3, #6574).
  • AWS Lambda: A network blip no longer stops the release ffmpeg build (8cd9c517c79be, #6569).
  • CLI: Capture waits for a mid-read navigation to settle and reads the page again once (013fe4e18ad7c, #6567).
  • CLI: A capture DNS helper that dies silently says how it ended (d571d77cae9d8, #6570).
  • Studio: Keep the canvas outline off the scaled preview iframe (624c9becfde73, #6452).
  • CLI: A snapshot clip whose frame fails is named with ffmpeg's reason (7a0c75bb69925, #6564).
  • CLI: A nearer copy of another version no longer hides the host's pinned onnxruntime-node (5561640809154, #6563).

Docs & Examples

  • Link the free lessons from the docs (0163ee11a75a3, #6588).
  • Links point at hyperframes.studio, the app's new home (6ae7c7688cec2, #6585).

Internal

  • No change-detection or reachability checkout can run into the one-minute limit (7fea875ede12d, #6577).
  • Engine: The test Chrome warms its first page in beforeAll; browser hooks get 30 s (c391b50163d0f, #6568).
  • CLI: Chrome-driving tests run in their own project after the rest (9b9dd7665499a, #6560).

HyperFrames v0.8.209

Released on 2026-10-27.

Chrome now closes quickly in every managed browser, and audio effects launch it like other renders. Previews load project media and HDR clips the way render does.

Fixes

  • CLI: Every managed browser closes within a second even if Chrome never exits (4416a41cba0a0, #6553).
  • Engine: Audio effects launch Chrome like every other render, sandbox retry included (c1da4a760e6f2, #6550).
  • Phone videos with an undecodable first audio track check, preview and render (cfef528d3ae1d, #6551).
  • CLI: An element marked data-layout-ignore no longer counts as covering text (41a7bc98f77b2, #6555).
  • Studio Server: An HDR clip previews and snapshots the way the SDR export renders it (404e8254e6ad0, #6537).
  • Studio Server: Preview loads root-path media, images and CSS from the project, as render does (60927853485dd, #6552).
  • Core: Text a script splits into letters shows once and carries the variable's value (7053aa90dd16e, #6543).

Internal

  • Studio: Record each edit-accuracy shard's file writes and reloads when HF_WRITE_TRACE is set (58552ede4bfff, #6532).

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed

  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

Fixed

  • Fixed chat-completions context estimates counting past thinking that the request drops (no reasoning replay), which triggered compaction far below the threshold (#15797, #17231 by @ghisguth)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Changed

  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Changed

  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 to the Factory Droid provider for accounts with Factory's 1017 flag; turning thinking off on its Baseten route disables reasoning instead of falling back to low effort (#17234 by @skipper019)

Changed

  • Made Kimi Code model discovery authoritative and cached per credential, added K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed to the bundled Kimi Code catalog, and preserved live thinking metadata there (#17224 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

Fixed

  • Codex model refresh now lists models available to an entitled account even when other saved accounts return HTTP 402 (#17198).
  • LiteLLM discovery now reads every /v2/model/info page before selecting the proxy's model roster, rather than caching only the first 50 entries; malformed or incomplete pagination falls back without caching a partial page (#17237 by @maykonmichel).
  • Fixed hosted web search on OpenAI Responses and Codex Responses selecting GPT-5.6 Luna instead of GPT-6 Luna (#17202 by @mateo-bolanos).

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Manual compactions (RPC compact, /compact, extension ctx.compact()) emit manual_compaction_start and manual_compaction_end session events, so RPC hosts can show compaction progress; docs/rpc.md documents these with the other progress events (retry_fallback_applied, ttsr_triggered, goal_updated) (#17247 by @Quelaan1)
  • Added retry.rateLimitWalksChain (default false): with it on, a 429 rate limit after a turn with signed Claude thinking moves to the next model in retry.fallbackChains at once instead of retrying the throttled model until retry.maxRetries is spent (#17232 by @sjawhar)
  • Sessions can be renamed from the resume picker: the new title persists as a user title without loading the session, and renames of live sessions are refused instead of forking the transcript (#17262 by @Twilight0)
  • Added display.advisorCollapsedLines (Settings → Appearance → Display) to cap how many note lines a collapsed advisor card shows; the default keeps the full preview (#17228 by @bluecapone)
  • omp config list --scope global|project lists only the keys that layer sets, with the values as written: path-scoped enabledModels, enabledProviders and disabledProviders entries ({ path, … }) stay unresolved, so a host can edit the global value without dropping them (#17246 by @Quelaan1)
  • tools.xdevNotices: false hides the xd://: mounted … notices shown as MCP servers connect, without turning on startup.quiet (#17263 by @MaisonnatM)

Changed

  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

Fixed

  • A running job's glance keeps the whole a meter counts instead of the bare numerator: a widget whose headline restated 140 beside a 140/190 bar now draws 140/190 in the job card, the HUD pill and the status line (#17226 by @iacore)
  • Fixed the managed-skills root guard rejecting a symlinked store outright; a root that resolves to a directory now accepts writes inside its target, while a broken link or a link to a non-directory is still refused (#17201 by @iacore)
  • Fixed experimental context rollover repeatedly running during tool calls when the fixed prompt and tool schemas already exceed the recovery band (#17205)
  • Fixed Ctrl+D during deferred extension startup falsely reporting an extension exit error and exiting 1 instead of closing cleanly (#17259).
  • Resuming a session, or reviving a parked or restored subagent, after a prewalk or plan-yolo handoff continues on the model and effort the handoff switched to instead of falling back to the planning model (#17229 by @shgew)
  • Fixed one interrupt silently stopping a session from ever waking on its own background job results again: an interrupt (Esc, the RPC abort command, an ACP cancel, a collab guest stop, an extension's ctx.abort()) that stops no run and no queued work no longer suppresses those wakes, and after an interrupt that did stop a run they come back once a later turn has run and ended. Esc on the "waiting on background jobs" row still ends that wait: its results land in context for your next prompt, as before (#17243 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed ! commands on zsh/fish waiting forever at interactive prompts (e.g. the Oh My Zsh update question on !code .); keystrokes now go to the running command while it runs, and Esc still cancels (#17210)
  • Fixed auto-compaction firing early on OpenAI-compatible chat-completions models that don't replay past reasoning (#15797, #17231 by @ghisguth)
  • Eval's tool.<name>(…) now accepts xd://<name> and the Claude Code mcp__<server>__<tool> spelling like direct tool calls, and reports registered but unavailable tools instead of "Unknown tool" (#17250)
  • Updated the ask prompt to encourage assistants to show missing decision context before the dialog opens (#17242 by @jasonharrison)
  • Custom LiteLLM providers now refresh cached model rosters after paginated /v2/model/info discovery was fixed; cached first-page-only lists no longer hide later-page models (#17237 by @maykonmichel).
  • Fixed hosted search repeating the same request when the active model is also its search target but uses a cloned or refitted model object (#17202 by @mateo-bolanos).
  • Fixed a killed or failed inline browser tab worker keeping its connection to the browser relay, which left Chrome's "started debugging this browser" bar on every tab until the omp session exited (#17212 by @nickzitzer)
  • Fixed a live tool card dropping the model's i intent, which the harness strips from the args tool_execution_start carries; the card now keeps it, so a bash call in Tern shows its description instead of a bare "Bash" as it already did in a resumed session (#17197 by @iacore)
  • RPC sessions now report settled (isSettled: true, session_settled) after a turn whose failed todo call queued a reminder for the next prompt, instead of appearing busy until another prompt arrives (#17238 by @kmccleary3301)
  • /annotate keeps notes and an unfinished note when the overlay is closed without sending them: reopening the same source restores them, Saved draft resumes any of the session's drafts, and Discard notes and close drops one (#17271 by @H4vC, based on #17230 by @Shadorain).
  • Annotation feedback names each note's source line, so notes on blank or repeated lines stay distinguishable (#17271 by @H4vC, based on #17230 by @Shadorain).
  • Fixed /tan clones ending without a final answer when they call ask; the clone now keeps running and the parent receives its final answer instead of an empty result (#17223 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Pasting in a terminal with enhanced paste (Tern, kitty) now lands in the open dialog's field — the agents hub's New agent description, an /annotate note — instead of the hidden prompt
  • Pasting or dropping an image file into the prompt in a terminal with enhanced paste (Tern, kitty) now attaches the image instead of typing its path
  • The plan review's edit button in Tern names your editor ("Edit in Notepad", "Edit in nvim") instead of "Edit in $EDITOR"
  • Fixed GitHub /review diff links keeping the snapshot that built the request after the cached diff refreshes in the background, instead of opening whatever file now sits at the same index (#16310 by @tkossak)

  • fix(coding-agent): keep prewalk handoff model across resume and revival by @shgew in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17229
  • fix(coding-agent): handled ctrl-d during guarded startup by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17260
  • fix(coding-agent): prevented futile context rollovers by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17206

  • feat(coding-agent): add retry.rateLimitWalksChain for the 429 chain walk after signed thinking by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17232
  • feat(coding-agent): emit manual_compaction_start/end session events for RPC hosts by @Quelaan1 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17247

v18.13.2 Stable2026-10-27T18:07:53Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added

  • AgentTool gained the optional handlesToolInterrupt flag: an interruptible tool that sets it (such as wait) still runs, without blocking, when a loop-owned interrupt is already queued, so it can drain the queued wake event instead of being skipped; user cancellation still skips it (#17174 by @alphastorm)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed OAuth logins shared by several processes being disabled with invalid_grant when they refreshed at the same time or one of them quit mid-refresh (#17128 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed transient Google 429 rate-limit and capacity responses retrying in place without blocking or rotating credentials, while daily caps and zero-entitlement limits still rotate (#17127 by @GTanger)
  • Fixed Aliyun DashScope's multimodal gateway failing a turn on its intermittent InvalidParameter 400s for valid inline images ("provided URL does not appear to be valid", "Download multimodal file timed out"); they are now retried (#17101 by @shuairongzeng)
  • Fixed a revoked or rejected GitHub Copilot credential continuing to show its last cached usage quota instead of being dropped (#17081)
  • Fixed Devin requests compressing the request body on the UI thread, which briefly froze the TUI on long conversations; requests under 1 KiB are now sent uncompressed

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added LM Studio decision models to discovery: models LM Studio reports as type: "decision" are listed as judge models served over its /v1/decisions endpoint, alongside its chat models (#17169 by @richiestanaway)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Extensions in the interactive TUI can read and directly switch plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes with ctx.sessionModes and observe changes with the mode_changed event, without submitting slash commands; extensionHandlers.modeControl: false turns off extension-driven mode changes (#15753 by @Shadorain)
  • RPC hosts can capture draft-only speech-to-text with live previews when speech input is enabled, without submitting an agent turn; slow flushes have adjustable deadlines, and failed transcription does not block a session change after capture closes (#17158 by @felipe-santos-aya).
  • Added discovery.advertisedReasoning to let a custom provider opt out of the reasoning ladder its /v1/models rows advertise (default true); discovery: proxy now reads that ladder, its none off-switch, and an explicit reasoning: false instead of building every model's thinking surface from the bundled catalog reference alone (#15255, #17077 by @Youwenqwq)
  • WATCHDOG.yml advisor entries now accept scope (main, subagent, or all, default all) to attach an advisor only to the top-level session or only to advised subagents, and includeReasoning: false to omit primary assistant _thinking:_ blocks from advisor review deltas (#17058 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Added session.worktreeScope to keep the resume picker scoped to one directory (#17061 by @Dante-dan).
  • LM Studio decision models can now serve the judge role (modelRoles.judge: lm-studio/<model>); they answer over LM Studio's /v1/decisions endpoint instead of being offered as chat models (#17169 by @richiestanaway)
  • Extensions' getAllTools() now reports mcpServerName, mcpToolName and mcpReadOnlyHint for MCP-backed tools, so an extension can tell read-only connector tools from ones that change things (#17120 by @cfpperche)
  • RPC: navigate_tree (move the leaf in the same session file, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch), abort_branch_summary and set_label, with matching RpcClient methods (#17138 by @andrebrait)
  • RPC: delta message_update frames (messageUpdates: "delta") now carry the block on start/end events and the message on a restart, so a client can rebuild the streaming message from deltas alone (#17137 by @andrebrait)
  • ctx.ui.input now accepts { secret: true } to mask typed characters as bullets in the TUI, forward an optional secret host hint on RPC extension_ui_request frames, and refuse plaintext form elicitation in ACP mode (#17080 by @GTanger)
  • Added opt-in gc.autoCompress (default off): interactive launches start a detached, low-priority omp gc --compress --apply at most once a day, so idle sessions are stored compressed without running the command; volumes where compression does not shrink a probe file (e.g. macOS 27) are skipped, and the latest run's output or skip reason is in gc-auto-compress.log in the agent dir (#17189 by @wolfiesch)
  • Added withFatLto to the Nix package: omp.override { withFatLto = false; } links pi-natives with thin LTO for faster builds (#13752 by @n3oney)

Changed

  • Bundled scout subagents now include ast_grep in their default tool list, matching the agent prompt's AST-search directive; scout stays read-only, so lsp (which can rename and apply code actions) is not added (#17151 by @sinhduc01)
  • Clearing a draft now brings back the idle recap and idle compaction it held off, a subagent view you return to gets the recap it still owed, and prompts, turn-starting messages and IRC wakes that arrive during idle compaction wait for it to finish; SDK owners can opt a session in with AgentSession.enableIdleMaintenance({ isBlocked, scheduledTurn, onRecap }) and refreshIdleMaintenance() (#17136 by @andrebrait)
  • TTSR interrupts include a bounded excerpt of the text that matched the rule, quoted as untrusted data with harness tags escaped; excerpts are retained once per stream, preserved alongside AST matches, and omitted for zero-width matches (#17099 by @shgew)
  • Sessions that load several provider-registering extensions into a shared model registry (subagents, /tan, SDK hosts) start faster: the model catalog is rebuilt once instead of once per extension (#17088 by @Delije4)
  • Qwen 3.8 models (for example Qwen3.8-Flash-Next served locally) now get the replace edit tool instead of hashline, like Kimi, DeepSeek and GLM 5.3 Flash; an explicit edit.mode, edit.modelVariants, PI_EDIT_VARIANT or PI_STRICT_EDIT_MODE still wins (#17096 by @ianderse)
  • ACP clients now receive each tool's name on tool_call, so tools without a specific ACP kind (task, wait, ask, …) show their own name instead of a generic "tool" label (#17162 by @epk)
  • /context now opens an interactive, read-only viewer of the active prompt, tools, messages, and thinking with estimated token usage and per-tool output, instead of the static usage report (#16160 by @C-W-Z).
  • Nix builds cache Rust dependencies and the native addon in separate derivations, so Rust edits no longer recompile every dependency and TypeScript edits reuse the addon (#13752 by @n3oney)

Fixed

  • Fixed ask questions being unanswerable while the prompt held a draft: Up/Down now hand the keyboard to the question (typing still goes to the draft until then), and the untouched draft is back in the prompt once the question is answered or cancelled (#17215 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the Agent Hub becoming unreachable after the last subagent finished: the people icon now stays (muted) while the session has subagents to inspect, and /subagents opens the hub as an alias of /hub (#17215 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed /goal pause leaving the goal tool active; pausing now restores the toolset from before the goal started (#15753 by @Shadorain)
  • Fixed /live flipping between listening and speaking at every pause in the assistant's speech; speaking now holds through short pauses (#17114)
  • Fixed the workflowz notice showing Python call forms in JS-only sessions and describing keep-alive workers when eval.workpool.freshAgents is on (#17152 by @bigHippoZz)
  • Fixed the first request after midnight or a working-directory change rewriting the conversation's first message, which broke OpenAI response chaining and the provider prompt cache, when an extension context handler or secret obfuscation was active, when an extension inserted its own message afresh on every request (superpowers' bootstrap), or when requests from one or more advisors ran in between; the new date or directory is now appended after the earlier turns, and is repeated when a side question (/btw) or a branch left out the turn that carried it (#17117 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed :auto on a retry fallback entry being ignored: a fixed-effort session now switches to auto thinking on that fallback instead of inheriting the failing turn's effort, and advisor fallbacks keep following the primary's effort without enabling unverified thinking (#17100 by @shgew)
  • Fixed ssh:// home-relative paths resolving against literal /~ instead of the remote account's home (#17182 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed searches of ssh:// directories failing with unsupported directory scans (#17182 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed clone-first worktrees carrying source-bound Python environments and CMake build trees, including self-ignored and nested directories (#17181 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed clean cloned worktrees carrying files ignored only by the source checkout, while retaining caches ignored by the target (#17181 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed glob patterns ending in / returning no directories or including matching files; directory-only constraints now work across local, URL, and multi-root searches (#17180 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed recursive skill:// glob and find discovery skipping contained linked directories; linked resources keep their skill URLs and directory cycles terminate (#17180 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed find treating nonempty linked files as empty and dropping them before judgment (#17180 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed JSON selectors failing on BOM-prefixed input, backup and extensionless files, and modifier-only queries (#17179 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed JSON selectors on ssh:// text files while preserving pagination and the remote read limit (#17179 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed tool.apply_patch(...) being rejected as an unknown tool in JavaScript eval when apply-patch editing is enabled (#17178 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed eval silently changing supplied cell deadlines without showing the requested and effective timeouts (#17178 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed unavailable Python remaining in eval's advertised languages and corrected its interpreter setup guidance (#17178 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed PDF archive members returning a binary-entry banner instead of converted text, with PDF selectors and page-image reads now supported (#17175 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed github run_watch labeling unavailable or partial failed-job logs as full logs, and included bounded fetch-failure reasons (#17173 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed github pr_create echoing large PR bodies in creation summaries and xd://github result details (#17173 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed raw URL reads prepending transport headers and normalizing response whitespace; raw URL bodies, ranges, and artifacts now share source-body coordinates (#17171 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed raw ranged reads adding elision rows, continuation notices for satisfied ranges, and conflict instructions to selected source text (#17171 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed read replacing a valid HTML page with a stale or missing guessed .md page; alternate representations now report their actual source URL (#16834)
  • Fixed implicit interactive autoResume failing every launch when a saved model cannot be restored and model fallback is disabled: startup now warns and opens a fresh session without carrying over the old history or cache identity, while preserving the original --max-time deadline. Saved-model diagnostics in the warning are sanitized and length-limited before display. Explicit resume and headless model-restoration restrictions remain unchanged (#17163 by @SAKANA-MOONLIGHT).
  • Fixed proc://<id>/mode reporting a known in-process job or agent as a missing service, and clarified that stdin and lifetime modes are services-only (#17170 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed Rex and other OSC 7501 terminals losing the working or blocked indicator when omp redraws a user message during a run (#17145)
  • Fixed hintless Google HTTP 429 model-capacity responses using the 45–75s model-capacity backoff instead of the short generic retry delay (#17127 by @GTanger)
  • Fixed skill:// reads, /skill: commands (terminal, ACP and RPC) and subagent autoload skills serving a plugin's old version, or failing with File not found, in a running session after omp plugin upgrade installed a new version; the session now rediscovers its skills and uses the upgraded files, whether or not the old version's directory was deleted (#17027 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed Esc on a busy session (and RPC abort_and_restore_queue) silently discarding queued messages from extensions and agents, such as pi.sendMessage steer/follow-up cards and agent-attributed prompts; they now appear in the transcript without restarting the run and reach the model with your next prompt (#17161 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a failed delivery of messages typed during compaction discarding other queued messages, such as an extension's prompt; only the messages that delivery queued are taken back, and messages anything else queued before, during or after it stay queued (#17161 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a failed delivery of messages typed during compaction sending the first of them twice: once now and again with the retried batch (#17161 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed --resume <file|id>, --continue, SessionManager.continueRecent(), the resume pickers and RPC open_session reviving an old copy of a conversation that had continued in a new file because omp could not keep writing the original (another omp process held it, or the file changed under it); resume now opens the copy with the newest turn, unless the original has turns of its own that copy lacks (for --resume, the pickers, and --continue or auto-resume of the terminal's last session), and says which file it picked; --continue and auto-resume without a record of the terminal's last session, and RPC open_session, take the copy with the newest turn among all linked copies, whichever one was written last. Copies saved before this fix are not linked and still resume as before (#17159 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a retry.fallbackChains entry naming another Claude model being skipped while the latest Claude turn carries signed thinking: the chain now moves to that entry when the failure is on another model, is not retried (an account-policy denial, a non-retryable error, or a wait past retry.maxDelayMs), or has spent its retries (#17115 by @sjawhar)
  • Anthropic composer predictions now cache the persisted conversation prefix; /btw follow-ups reuse stable topic history without caching regenerated image descriptions (#17186)
  • Fixed wait returning a skipped-tool error for background completions, peer messages, or parent steering queued before execution (#17174 by @alphastorm)
  • Session-stop extensions now pass all continuation messages to the agent instead of silently discarding every message after the first; blocking decisions still take priority (#17129 by @aktanazat)
  • Fixed the crash and SIGTERM recovery hint offering omp --resume <id> for a session that was never saved to disk, which --resume cannot load; such a session now prints no resume command (#17119 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed Ctrl+V over SSH pasting the server's clipboard when the client terminal forwards the key instead of pasting (e.g. Tern on Windows into a macOS host); omp now leaves the remote clipboard alone and points you to your terminal's paste shortcut (#17149 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed apply_patch committing unmatched old/context text or dropping numeric prefixes; matching now uses complete lines without changing other edit modes' fuzzy behavior (#17184 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed context-free apply_patch line deletions leaving blank rows, including first, last and only lines (#17184 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed apply_patch rejecting move-only updates and move-then-add envelopes; moves preserve source bytes and permissions and later sections see the ordered file state (#17184 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed omp plugin commands applying changes under --dry-run: upgrade and omp update --plugins --check now preview, and actions without a preview reject the flag (#17104 by @sjawhar)
  • Turning off async.widgets mid-session now stops spec requests for already-shown job widgets and aborts any request in flight (#17090 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed learn not hot-registering a newly minted or updated managed skill in the active session (session.skills, skill://, and the system prompt), and fixed composeRecallQuery dropping prior user turns when an earlier turn repeated the latest prompt (#17113 by @GTanger)
  • Fixed @path file mentions skipping .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, and .epub files as binary instead of converting them to Markdown with markit like CLI @file arguments and read (#17193 by @GTanger)
  • Fixed an automatic retry fallback (a hop down retry.fallbackChains or the Fireworks Fast degrade) re-rendering the system prompt for the new model, which made Anthropic write the whole cached conversation again on each hop; a hop now keeps the Model line and Delegation wording, and rebuilds only when the new model needs a different edit mode, tool-description handling, or tool set (#17014 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a live subagent's system prompt re-rendering its peer list, with each peer's current activity, on every rebuild, which made Anthropic write the whole cached conversation again; the list now updates only when a rebuild changes the rest of the prompt, and history:// lists the current peers (#17014 by @sjawhar)
  • SQLite row selectors now avoid shadowed ROWID aliases so reads, updates, and deletes target the intended single row. (#16998, #17001 by @ai-yang)
  • Fixed composer predictions offering notes relayed in from other agents or sessions (for example an orchestrator's pasted status note) as the user's next message; predictions now cover only what the person at the keyboard would type (#17185 by @wolfiesch)
  • Fixed image descriptions using the first vision model in catalog order (such as claude-fable-5) when no vision model is configured; they now use the least expensive priced vision-capable model (#17148, #17196 by @gcp)
  • Fixed wait results and background job deliveries naming a finished subagent only by a job id that differs from its agent id (e.g. Foo-2 for a messaged agent's new turn), where agent://Foo-2 and history://Foo-2 are not found; they now name history://Foo, plus agent://Foo when that turn published its output (#17112 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed RpcClient.promptAndWait() hanging until its timeout when the agent process exits or the client stops after the prompt was acknowledged; it now rejects right away (#17135 by @andrebrait)
  • Fixed reading versioned Read the Docs pages serving the development branch's source file instead of the requested version's content when the page's Edit link targets another branch (#17091 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed RPC startup hanging when an extension opens a dialog during session_start: the client can now answer it, and other commands still wait for startup to finish, in order (#17139 by @andrebrait)
  • Fixed extension tools disappearing once the startup plan mode (plan.defaultOnStartup) was paused or its plan approved: tools of extensions that load after startup now stay, while built-ins that plan mode registered, such as its write transport, still go (#17085 by @appboypov)
  • Fixed a batch task call silently ignoring a model (or sourceSession) on a non-seance item while the seance agent is hidden, so the child ran on its own model; the call is now refused with the same error as a single-agent call (#17107 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed an edit under an older [path#TAG] header, after another edit had changed the file, applying to lines that read never displayed, including a line it had cut at the column cap; such an edit now shows the anchored lines first, as it does under the file's current tag (#16208, #17033 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed omp gc --compress (and the gc.autoCompress background run) taking minutes on large session histories (#17195 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed omp gc --compress --apply spending time on every idle session where the filesystem does not actually compress files (e.g. macOS 27); it now reports compress skipped: <reason>, and gc.autoCompress no longer slows interactive startup with that check (#17195 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Fixed

  • Fixed local embeddings using one spinning CPU thread per core, so a single recall query cost several CPU-seconds on a many-core machine (#17109 by @sjawhar)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added opt-in, cycle-safe descendant-link traversal to native glob through followLinks, leaving default traversal unchanged (#17180 by @alphastorm)

Changed

  • Faster native line, word, and structured patch diffs on large edits (#17015 by @GTanger)

Fixed

  • Fixed the built-in sort using many times its -S buffer size, or more memory than its container allows or the machine has available, on inputs of short lines, and ignoring timeout or a cancel while it sorts (#17155 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the built-in sort -m and sort -c splitting lines longer than their read buffer, and sort joining a file's unterminated last line to the next file's first line (#17155 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the built-in sort -S N% using the wrong buffer size: -S 50% gave 0 bytes and -S 100% a thousand times the machine's memory; it is now N percent of physical memory as in GNU sort (#17155 by @sjawhar)
  • Exited bash-tool & jobs are reaped without another command; wait still reports their status, and $! works inside pipelines, subshells, and command substitutions (#17144).
  • On macOS, the bash tool's built-in ps includes other users' processes and unreaped zombies when selecting a PID (#17144).
  • Fixed native glob file-type filters discarding target size and modification time for linked files (#17180 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed leading UTF-8 BOMs causing embedded jq JSON input parse errors while preserving raw-input bytes (#17179 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed the shell's timeout and tool aborts not stopping built-in commands that were still reading (cat /dev/zero, huge files, FIFOs with no writer) (#17141 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a tool abort leaving a background in-process command, such as cat /dev/zero > /dev/null &, running and keeping a core busy after its shell session was gone (#17141 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a shell redirect to or from a FIFO whose other end is a background job, such as echo hi > f & cat < f, hanging the command; a tool abort now also stops a write redirect to a FIFO that has no reader (#17141 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a background external command with a FIFO redirect, such as /bin/cat < f & echo hi > f, hanging the shell until the FIFO's other end opened; the command's own process now opens it, as in bash (#17141 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed timeout printing error: interrupted when its limit stopped a built-in command; like GNU timeout, it now prints nothing of its own and exits 124 (#17141 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed crackling in live voice playback: the assistant's speech now absorbs packet jitter without dropping out, short turns play without waiting for the next response, and lost packets no longer insert extra synthesized audio (#17114)
  • Fixed the bash tool's rm -r and du crashing the whole session with a stack overflow on a directory tree thousands of levels deep; rm -r also removes such a tree without running out of file descriptors, and reports a directory that is its own ancestor instead of descending into it (#17021 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the bash tool's find panicking and writing a native panic report to ~/.omp/logs when the command reading its output exits early, as in find . -printf '%p\n' | head -1, or when its stderr is closed; it now stops quietly, and a failed -fprintf write is reported instead of find: internal error (#17079 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Fixed the shell's built-in grep and rg running the whole agent out of memory on a file with no line breaks, such as a large sparse file: a line over 256 MiB is now reported as not searched for that file and the search continues, and a -f pattern file over 256 MiB is refused with exit status 2 (#17108 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the embedded shell's globs keeping matches whose literal tail does not exist: ls -d DIR/*/ now lists only directories instead of passing every file as file/, and */name keeps only matches that contain name, as in bash (#17110 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the embedded shell ignoring shopt -s globstar: ** now matches any number of directory levels as in bash (**/*.rs finds files at every depth, also in compgen -G), and a timeout or interrupt stops a long ** expansion (#17111 by @sjawhar)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added a frame-write listener (TUI.addFrameWriteListener) for terminal integrations that need to react to emitted ANSI output, including resize paints (#17145)
  • HookInputComponent (showHookInput) now accepts { secret: true } to mask typed characters as bullets (•) in input overlays (#17080 by @GTanger)
  • Added an ANSI and native /context viewer with category navigation, content inspection, token-usage and compaction estimates, and keyboard/mouse controls that adapt across Tern and other terminals (#16160 by @C-W-Z).

Fixed

  • Fixed AskDialogComponent's draft input guard holding the keyboard until the draft was cleared; Up/Down (or a pointer action) now release it so the question can be answered with the draft parked, and syncPresentation receives the effective blocked state (#17215 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the prompt editor's autocomplete popup (e.g. emoji suggestions after :D) staying open and following the cursor after Shift/Ctrl/Alt+Enter inserted a newline, so the next Enter submitted past a stale list; newlines and cursor motion (arrows, Home/End, word jumps, character jumps) now close it (#17215 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed run_watch failed-job rows hiding why a job's logs are unavailable; multiline gh errors now stay on one row (#17173 by @alphastorm)

Removed

  • Removed the static context usage report (ContextUsageView, renderContextUsage, describeContextUsage), contextUsageHead(), and the glyph and color fields of ContextBreakdown categories; use ContextViewer (#16160 by @C-W-Z).
  • Fixed Markdown tables inside list items disappearing from the terminal transcript (#17165).

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added

  • Added deadlineMs and waitMessage cleanup registration options: shutdown waits longer for that callback, but only while it is still pending, and says so on stderr once nothing else is left to wait for (#17128 by @sjawhar)
  • A process stopped by SIGTERM now prints its registered recovery commands after the terminal is handed back, so a stopped omp session shows omp --resume <id> instead of leaving its last frame above the shell prompt like a crash (#17119 by @sjawhar)

Fixed

  • Fixed plain TAR archives requiring a whole-container memory buffer to list entries or read a selected member (#17175 by @alphastorm)

What's Changed

  • fix(coding-agent): keep composer predictions from echoing relayed agent notes by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17185
  • feat(coding-agent): compress idle sessions in the background with gc.autoCompress by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17189
  • fix(edit): ran the seen-line guard on the stale-tag recovery path by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17033
  • fix(builtins): stop find quietly when its output or stderr pipe closes by @trukhinyuri in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17079
  • fix(coding-agent): keep extension tools registered while startup plan mode is on by @appboypov in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17085
  • fix(coding-agent): only fetch ReadTheDocs raw source when ref matches version slug by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17091
  • fix(task): refuse seance-only fields on batch items when seance is hidden by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17107
  • fix(grep,rg): bound the line buffer and pattern files so one file cannot exhaust the host by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17108
  • fix(shell): drop glob matches whose literal tail does not exist by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17110
  • fix(coding-agent): name agent:// and history:// for task jobs whose id is not the agent id by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17112
  • fix(rpc): reject acknowledged prompts when the client stops or the transport closes by @andrebrait in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17135

Wei-Shaw/sub2api ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.2.19Sub2API 0.2.19 Stable2026-10-28T10:16:00Z

AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增按操作与资源范围授权的管理员 API Key；OpenAI / Composite 分组支持按实际出图张数计费，并新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型支持。

新增功能

  • 管理员 API Key：可按操作和资源范围授权，支持过期时间和 IP 白名单；只保存不可逆摘要，撤销记录保留用于审计
  • 按张计费：OpenAI 和 Composite 分组新增「按张计费」开关（默认关闭），一次生成多张图时按上游实际返回的张数计费，只对专用图片端点生效
  • OpenAI：支持 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
  • Gemini：同账号重试次数可通过 gateway.max_same_account_retries_gemini 配置（默认 4，范围 0–10）
  • Grok：管理端新增账号模型目录诊断，可查看来源、可信状态和与本地映射的差异；手动同步和后台观察统一使用同一套解析规则

优化改进

  • Gemini：刷新默认模型列表，移除已停用的 2.0/2.5 系列和 3-pro-preview；连接测试默认模型改为 gemini-3.5-flash
  • Gemini：分组内账号都配置了模型映射时，/v1beta/models 列表和详情按声明的模型返回，与 /v1/models 口径一致
  • Gemini：绑定显式缓存的请求在池模式上游网关账号上，按配置在同一账号重试
  • 国产 Coding Plan 账号遇到请求频率型 429 时改为秒级冷却，不再停调到 5h 窗口结束
  • 模型列表刷新在并发冷启动时不再重复请求上游
  • Grok：原生 Responses 和各转换路径都会记录上游原始响应模型，便于审计

Bug 修复

  • 修复 Gemini 以 fileData 形式返回的图片未计费的问题
  • 修复渠道按次计费的图片档位丢失 token 用量的问题
  • 修复 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在 9 月 14 日之后定价失效的问题
  • 修复 DeepSeek prompt_cache_hit_tokens 未计为缓存读取的问题
  • 修复 OpenCode 转发 DeepSeek 时 developer 角色导致 422 的问题
  • 修复 Antigravity 非流式畸形工具调用返回空成功响应的问题
  • 修复超大 multipart 图片上传被静默截断的问题，现在直接拒绝
  • 修复分页参数过大时偏移量溢出导致 500 的问题
  • 修复管理员保护规则校验返回 500 的问题，现返回 400
  • 修复保存渠道时覆盖 web_search_emulation 平台维度的问题
  • 修复模型广场分组模型定价被图片兜底档位覆盖的问题
  • 修复 Grok 模型目录快照被失败请求、乱序请求或旧表单覆盖的问题

升级指南

  • 本版本包含数据库迁移 247（scoped_admin_api_keys 表）和 248（groups.image_count_billing 列），启动时会自动执行
  • Gemini 默认模型列表已移除 2.x 系列；仍需使用这些模型的账号请自行在白名单或模型映射中配置

📥 Installation

Docker:

# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.19

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.19

One-line install (Linux):

curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash

Manual download: Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

📚 Documentation

  • GitHub Repository
  • Installation Guide

roboflow/supervision ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
0.31.3supervision-0.31.3 Stable2026-10-28T08:39:02Z

v0.31.3 — Grayscale annotators, OpenCV-exact fallbacks, and merged YOLO polygons

Grayscale scenes work with more annotators, the pure NumPy fallback matches OpenCV pixel for pixel, and YOLO export handles multi-part masks.

  • YOLO export merges multi-part masks into one polygon and skips crowd annotations, with flags for the old output.
  • Background overlay and comparison annotators draw on grayscale scenes.
  • Without OpenCV, resize, blur, blending, drawing and connected components give the same pixels as OpenCV.
  • Invalid input fails early: ImageSink, the video frame generator and depth arrays now raise clear errors.
  • Short hex colors such as "#f0f" work in annotators.

Drop-in upgrade unless you export YOLO labels: the default output changes, see the Migration guide.

✨ Spotlights / highlights

YOLO export merges multi-part masks and skips crowd annotations

DetectionDataset.as_yolo now omits detections whose iscrowd flag is set and writes a mask with several disconnected parts as one merged polygon line instead of one line per part. Both are on by default. The merge is done by the new sv.merge_multi_segment, which joins the parts through zero-width seams at their nearest vertices. (#2786)

import supervision as sv

dataset = sv.DetectionDataset(...)
dataset.as_yolo(
    images_directory_path="images",
    annotations_directory_path="labels",
    data_yaml_path="data.yaml",
)  # 0.31.3: crowd skipped, one merged polygon line per mask

dataset.as_yolo(
    images_directory_path="images",
    annotations_directory_path="labels",
    data_yaml_path="data.yaml",
    ignore_crowd=False,
    merge_segments=False,
)  # the 0.31.2 output

sv.merge_multi_segment

New public function. Pass it the polygon parts of one mask and get back a single polygon. (#2786)

import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

a = np.array([[0, 0], [10, 0], [10, 10], [0, 10]])
b = np.array([[30, 30], [40, 30], [40, 40], [30, 40]])
sv.merge_multi_segment([a, b]).shape
# (10, 2)

Annotators on grayscale scenes

BackgroundOverlayAnnotator and ComparisonAnnotator now draw on scenes shaped (H, W) or (H, W, 1), or given as a Pillow "L" image, instead of raising ValueError. Short hex colors such as "#f0f" now work in annotators and sv.hex_to_rgba. (#2832, #2803, #2801)

import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

scene = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
detections = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[20, 20, 60, 60]], dtype=float), class_id=np.array([0])
)
sv.BackgroundOverlayAnnotator().annotate(scene.copy(), detections).shape
# (100, 100)  (0.31.2: ValueError)

The NumPy fallback matches OpenCV pixel for pixel

Without OpenCV installed, resize (INTER_LINEAR on uint8), blur, addWeighted, thin lines, circles, filled polygons that leave the canvas, connectedComponents and mean now give the same pixels as OpenCV. BlurAnnotator, HaloAnnotator, HeatMapAnnotator, PixelateAnnotator, the blending annotators, sv.resize_image, sv.letterbox_image and PolygonZone masks are affected. (#2833, #2836, #2811, #2808, #2810, #2812, #2820)

Bad input fails early

sv.ImageSink(overwrite=False) raises FileExistsError instead of replacing an existing image, sv.get_video_frames_generator rejects a stride below 1, and DepthMap.from_ultralytics rejects unwrapped integer arrays. (#2800, #2819, #2795)

import supervision as sv

for frame in sv.get_video_frames_generator("video.mp4", stride=0):
    ...
# ValueError: stride must be >= 1, got 0

🔄 Migration guide

One default behavior changes: YOLO export. No public symbol was removed or renamed in this release, and nothing is deprecated.

YOLO export defaults affect sv.DetectionDataset.as_yolo, and save_yolo_annotations and detections_to_yolo_annotations in supervision.dataset.formats.yolo. Before 0.31.3 export skipped nothing and wrote a mask with several disconnected parts as one polygon line per part. From 0.31.3 export drops detections whose iscrowd flag is set in detections.data, and writes the parts of a mask as one merged polygon line. Label files exported with 0.31.3 can therefore differ from those exported with 0.31.2 for the same dataset. (#2786)

  • Nothing to do if you want crowd annotations dropped and one polygon line per mask.
  • To keep the 0.31.2 output, pass ignore_crowd=False and merge_segments=False to as_yolo.
  • Re-export datasets you trained on from 0.31.2 labels only if the crowd or multi-part masks matter to your training run.

Three bug fixes also turn silent behavior into an error: ImageSink(overwrite=False) raises FileExistsError for an existing image (#2800), get_video_frames_generator raises ValueError for a stride below 1 (#2819), and DepthMap.from_ultralytics rejects unwrapped integer arrays (#2795).

📝 Notable changes

🚀 Added

  • sv.merge_multi_segment — joins the disconnected polygon segments of one mask into a single polygon. (#2786)
  • ignore_crowd and merge_segments — new parameters on DetectionDataset.as_yolo, save_yolo_annotations and detections_to_yolo_annotations. (#2786)
  • Depth showcase example — examples/depth_showcase runs Depth Anything V2 Large, Apple Depth Pro and a YOLO depth model through sv.DepthAnnotator on video files, webcams and streams. (#2804, #2818)

🌱 Changed

  • DetectionDataset.as_yolo now skips crowd annotations and writes multi-part masks as one merged polygon line. Pass ignore_crowd=False and merge_segments=False for the previous output. (#2786)

🔧 Fixed

Annotators

  • BackgroundOverlayAnnotator and ComparisonAnnotator raised ValueError on grayscale scenes. (#2832, #2803)
  • Annotators and sv.hex_to_rgba rejected 3- and 4-digit short hex colors such as "#f0f". (#2801)

Input validation, I/O and metrics

  • ImageSink(overwrite=False) silently replaced an existing image, including through a dangling symlink; it now raises FileExistsError, and a path with an embedded null character raises ValueError. (#2800)
  • get_video_frames_generator could yield frames past end for stride=0 or a negative stride; it now raises ValueError. (#2819)
  • DepthMap.from_ultralytics accepted unwrapped integer arrays as depth values. (#2795)
  • KeyPoints.as_detections and with_nms let an extra coordinate change the boxes; they now use x/y only. (#2817)
  • MeanAverageRecall.compute() raised IndexError when filtering by object size with shared scalar metadata. (#2791)
  • download_assets(VideoAssets.GROCERY_STORE) failed MD5 verification; the catalog now holds the checksum of the hosted file. (#2804)

NumPy fallback without OpenCV

  • resize with INTER_LINEAR on uint8 images now matches OpenCV pixel for pixel; arm64 builds that hand some grayscale and RGBA resizes to the Carotene HAL can differ by up to two levels. (#2833)
  • addWeighted rounds 8-bit, 16-bit and float32 blends like OpenCV. (#2836)
  • blur rounds 8-bit results like OpenCV. (#2811)
  • line, polylines, drawContours and circle at thickness 1, and filled circles, match OpenCV; a negative circle radius raises ValueError. (#2808)
  • fillPoly and filled drawContours match OpenCV for polygons that leave the canvas. (#2810)
  • connectedComponents and connectedComponentsWithStats number 8-connected components in OpenCV's order. (#2812)
  • mean keeps small values when large positive and negative float32 pixels cancel. (#2820)

🏆 Contributors

Welcome to our first-time contributors: Oke Iyanuoluwa Enoch, Maidul Hasan Masum, Jooyoung Lim, Zhenhuan Wang, Shreya Boyane, Carlos Marañes, Vuln3rat0r and reuben rouse!

  • Oke Iyanuoluwa Enoch (@Iyanuoluwa007, LinkedIn) — made the NumPy fallback match OpenCV for thin lines, circles, polygons, blur and connected components, and added strict type checking across the tests.
  • LEE, WEI-HONG (@AuricTW) — made ImageSink refuse to overwrite existing images, rejected non-positive frame strides, and kept float32 precision in the mean fallback.
  • kevin (@kevin9327) — made the NumPy fallback resize and addWeighted match OpenCV.
  • A Aswanth Raj (@aswanth-07, LinkedIn) — built key point boxes from x/y coordinates and kept scalar metadata in recall size buckets.
  • Vuln3rat0r (@Vuln3rat0r) — added sv.merge_multi_segment and merged multi-part masks in YOLO export.
  • Mohammad Hijjawi (@MohammadHijjawi97, LinkedIn) — made BackgroundOverlayAnnotator work on grayscale scenes.
  • Shreya Boyane (@Sonica-B, LinkedIn) — made ComparisonAnnotator work on grayscale scenes.
  • Carlos Marañes (@cmaranes) — accepted short hex colors in annotators.
  • reuben rouse (@reubenjrouse, LinkedIn) — rejected unwrapped integer arrays in DepthMap.from_ultralytics.
  • Jooyoung Lim (@mmporong, LinkedIn) — fixed docstring examples that were not valid Python.
  • Maidul Hasan Masum (@mh-masum6875) — added type checking to the dataset, metrics and detection tests.
  • Zhenhuan Wang (@NaCr05) — enabled strict typing for the conversion and iterable tests.
  • Jirka Borovec (@Borda, LinkedIn) — added the depth showcase example and prepared the release.

neovim/neovim ↗ 1 release · 1 prerelease
nightlyNvim development (prerelease) build Prerelease2026-10-28T05:19:41Z 
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1959+g61e71ccf8a
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792527110

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

  • Install by package manager

stablyai/orca ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.4.243 Stable2026-10-28T04:08:34Z

Chrome extensions in Orca’s browser, iPhone Duo support, and Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui 🧩

This release brings Chrome extensions to Orca’s browser under experimental, lets a conversation continue in Chat once you quit its agent in the terminal, and shows your local worktrees sooner after a restart. It also adds support for the folding iPhone Duo, compact native-style menus, light and dark themes on the phone, and fixes for Windows terminals, SSH hosts and updates.

The short version

  • Chrome extensions (experimental): Add extensions from the Chrome Web Store with Add to Orca, so password managers like Bitwarden and 1Password can fill logins in Orca’s browser. Off by default.
  • Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui: Once you quit Claude or Codex in a terminal, the same conversation can continue in Chat while the terminal tab stays open. Claude chats also keep their saved approval choice across model changes, and closing a chat that’s still working asks first.
  • Worktrees sooner after a restart: Local worktrees load before terminals restore, and the sidebar says discovery is still running instead of showing an empty list.
  • Steadier terminals: Windows terminals keep their history through width changes, slept terminals wake in the folder you left, macOS’s built-in bash keeps command tracking in order after a DEBUG trap change, and copying from pi on a remote host reaches your clipboard.
  • Orchestration: Choose the worker heartbeat interval or turn heartbeats off, and reduce CPU use by stopping settled workers from polling for commands.
  • Polish where it counts: Compact native-style menus, VS Code–style Markdown highlighting with sticky headings, and update checks through your Settings proxy.
  • Fixes from the community: Quit and Stop All Sessions, math in chats, Copy Remote URL with line ranges, IME highlighting in terminals, fnm on Windows, and Japanese and Chinese translations all work better.

Phone & web updates: Phones get light and dark themes, support for the folding iPhone Duo, PDFs in Quick Look and copy buttons in chats. Many phone screens now follow desktop’s rules for chats, Source Control and terminals, and typing and scrolling in long chats stay fast.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

  • Fresh terminal host: New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply, including continuing a chat after its terminal agent exits. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
  • Browser extensions (experimental): Turn on Settings → Experimental → Browser extensions, restart, then open the Chrome Web Store in an Orca browser tab. Extensions run in local browser profiles only. Ad blockers install but don’t block yet, and some extensions, such as Tampermonkey, don’t work.
  • Worker heartbeats: Heartbeats stay on every 5 minutes by default. Changes in Settings → Agent Orchestration apply to newly dispatched workers; workers already running keep their brief, and older hosts keep 5 minutes.
  • Claude subagent navigation: The eye that marked the subagent you’re viewing is gone. The viewed subagent row uses the normal current-row highlight.

thedotmack/claude-mem ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v15.4.0 Stable2026-10-28T03:38:07Z

My Work: focus areas, and requests that file themselves

Focus areas are the top level of My Work (#5131)

  • MY FOCUS rail. Your focus areas are listed in priority order, with a needs-you count on each. Every request sits in exactly one area, or in Other. On phones the areas appear as a chip row.
  • Area header. Each area page shows its goal sentence, combined progress, your own quotes, the asks you haven't started yet, and a link to Past focus. The My Goals page is retired; its content now lives here.
  • Suggested. New areas appear here by themselves. You can Keep, Rename, Merge or Dismiss each one, with Undo. Your decisions sync across computers and a refresh never overrides them.
  • Owner-goals sorts what it mines. It applies three tests in order, so each statement becomes exactly one focus area, ask or rule. Priorities and open asks no longer duplicate each other.
  • The Focus step replaces Align in the automatic refresh. It places every request, and it proposes new areas from Other or from a request that holds several separate asks.
  • Request cards. Every card shows its area, and request detail has Move to…. "What came out of it" is now called Deliverables.

The judge files new conversations under their request (#5110)

  • Before any grouping agent runs, each new conversation is filed: a code link (the same work-state list or request_id) joins at once. On CMEM Pro, or with your own OpenRouter key, Jev also checks whether the conversation continues one of your open requests. At a check score of 0.8 or more it joins. Between 0.5 and 0.8 you get a Join / Not this suggestion on the card. Otherwise it starts its own request.
  • Focus areas too. On the same installs, Jev suggests a focus area for each request before the Focus step runs. The pick is only a hint to the Focus agent for now: automatic placement waits until enough of your own moves exist to calibrate a cutoff.
  • Without Jev, everything works as before.

A request keeps its conversations across project roots (#5106)

  • A request whose decision names its project root keeps conversations from other roots, and later refreshes can still add to it.

Fixes

  • The sync-api query-plan test applies its own schema, so it no longer fails depending on test order.

CMEM Pro: the Jev decisions gateway (/api/inference/v1/decisions) is live for Pro subscribers.
